name: Giovanni Battista Tiepolo
findings: Within his own canvases, navy turns up as a small accent in 50% of the paintings that hold it, 2.9x the archive's rate (from 831 paintings here).
Within his own canvases, reed green turns up as the lightest note in 100% of the paintings that hold it, 2.8x the archive's rate (from 831 paintings here).
Within his own canvases, roman green turns up as the shadow in 50% of the paintings that hold it, 2.1x the archive's rate (from 831 paintings here).
Rarely uses dark olive brown, common in the same museum(s)' other paintings (from 831 paintings here).
Pairs dresden brown with ochre brown more than chance would predict (3 of 831 paintings here).
Pairs dresden brown with honey yellow more than chance would predict (3 of 831 paintings here).
His single largest palette family (smoky black, white, dark walnut) covers 66% of his paintings here.
Keeps 2 distinct palette families here, from smoky black, white to smoky black, dark olive brown.
